column1: At Amazon, we take a science-based, customer-centric approach to climate. We use a structured life cycle assessment model to
measure and map environmental hotspots across our value chain. We have conducted a sustainability materiality assessment to
identify the most significant environmental topics across our business. We categorize climate risks and opportunities by taking into
account customer and stakeholder expectations, regulations, business risks, industry best practices, and emerging news. Amazon
embeds a variety of mechanisms in our business operations to address sustainability issues, including climate-related risks. We
integrate sustainability practices into our everyday operations through goal-setting, metrics, and quarterly business reviews.
We have an established governance framework to help ensure that risks associated with climate change are considered at the
most senior levels of our business.
